dict.string: Jarvis uses the microphone only when the owner starts a voice command.
Jarvis transcribes voice commands on this Mac.
Jarvis captures only the active or specifically requested open window when the owner confirms a scan.
Jarvis controls applications only when directed by the owner.
Jarvis reads your agenda and creates events only after you approve the exact change.
Jarvis reads reminders and creates them only after you approve the exact change.
Jarvis uses Contacts to resolve people you explicitly name.
